children: John Marshall Bancorp has agreed to buy fellow Virginia bank holding company Eagle Financial Services for about $253 million in stock.

Reston-based John Marshall on Tuesday said it will issue two shares, worth $46.72 based on Friday's closing price of $23.36, for each share of Eagle, an 11.5% premium to Friday's closing price of $41.90 for the Berryville company.
John Marshall said the deal, slated to close early in the first quarter of 2027, will create a combined company with 23 banking offices and total assets topping $4 billion.
